title: A copied Size measurement keeps saying its own size
goal: When someone copies a Size measurement (Option-drag, or copy and paste), the copy is named "Size 274 × 62 copy", and from then on its name no longer follows its numbers: resize the copy and its name and Measurements row still say the old size.
notes: Seen in Scripts/playtest/size-steps-and-resizes-walk.json on 2026-10-16: an Option-drag copy of the pill measurement was named "Size 274 × 62 copy" (expectSizeMeasure failed: the Size measurement is called "Size 274 × 62 copy"). MeasureSizeGroup.isAutomaticName("Size 274 × 62 copy") is false ("62 copy" is not a number), so keepSizeMeasureNamesInStep never renames it; the resize rename was not run on the copy, that half is read from the code. Copy naming is in duplicateLayers.
acceptance: A copied Size measurement is named for what it measures, the way a fresh one is
Resizing the copy renames it to its new size, in the same undo step
A walk at Next defaults copies a Size measurement, resizes the copy and claims its name
